name: multi-agent-router
description: Chooses which local agent, skill, or workflow should handle a task based on context and risk.

skills.description: Chooses which local agent, skill, or workflow should handle a task based on context and risk.

prompts.description: Prompt for running the Multi-Agent Router workflow.

targetSupport.claude-code: Installs as a Claude Code skill directory with SKILL.md as the entry point.
targetSupport.codex: Installs as a Codex skill pack with a generated AGENTS.md bridge.
targetSupport.github-copilot: Installs as a GitHub Copilot project skill under .github/skills with a generated SKILL.md bridge.
targetSupport.opencode: Installs as a Packsmith OpenCode skill directory with PACKSMITH.md bridge notes.
targetSupport.cursor: Installs as a Cursor rule pack with a generated .mdc rule and copied Packsmith assets.
targetSupport.trae: Installs as a local TRAE Skill directory with a generated SKILL.md bridge and copied Packsmith assets.
